                 body: "Crashes (v1.4.0, commit 9c41e7a): cr_1e2ea0 (x2, POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done) and cr_ee551c (GET /v1/reminders/rem_0001). Panic: nil pointer dereference at api/reminders.go:144 in (*API).owned.\n\nCause: store/store.go (*Store).Get sets r = nil for a soft-deleted reminder but leaves err nil, so it returns (nil, nil). Its doc says deleted reminders are not returned. owned() then reads rem.UserID. The request sequence in the logs is: create rem_0001, DELETE it, then GET/POST done on it.\n\nFix: in Get, the deleted case returns ErrNotFound, so callers get a 404 through the existing error path.\n\nReproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound (fails before the fix, passes after)."

                 id: 102
                 body: "Root cause: notify/notify.go Dispatcher.Stop calls close(d.stop) every time, so a second POST /v1/admin/dispatcher/stop panics. Fix: Stop now closes the channel inside a sync.Once (stopOnce). Reproducer: notify/stop_twice_test.go TestStopTwice, which fails before the change and passes after. Full suite passes."
  model asks:  issue_comment
                 id: 101
                 body: "Root cause: auth/auth.go parseBearer (line 63) checks HasPrefix(h, \"Bearer\") with no space, then does strings.SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1]. A header of exactly \"Bearer\" gives a one-element slice, so indexing [1] panics (cr_f9ee9e, 3 times, from an okhttp client). Fix: check for the prefix \"Bearer \" with the space, or check len(parts) == 2 before indexing. A reproducer test would be auth/bearer_test.go, with inputs \"Bearer\", \"Bearer \", \"Bearerx tok1\" expecting ok=false. I could not apply it: writes under auth/ are blocked by a protection rule, so this still needs a person with access to auth/."
